name: stabilized_water
description: Shared test instance (c): the real Opus Magnum chapter-1 puzzle Stabilized Water (campaign P007). Reagent/product molecules byte-decoded from the game's P007.puzzle via omsim's parser (see NOTES.md and picat/NOTES.md): reagent = one water atom; product = salt@(0,0) normal-bonded to water@(1,0). Following the picat arm, the game's two single-water reagent sites are modeled as ONE respawning input with pool 2 (see harness/SPEC.md, reconciliation decision 5). Parts modeled: 1 arm (length 1), 1 glyph of calcification, 1 glyph of bonding.
